jobs.description_text: Xantium Academy Fellow We seek top early-career professionals to join our inaugural Xantium Academy Fellowship commencing the summer of 2027. This six-month accelerated program blends structured mentorship, classroom theory, and hands-on practice across fluid tracks in Trading or Analysis. Supported by active executive sponsorship – including direct engagement with Xantium Co-Founders – Fellows will make immediate contributions through real-world projects. We plan to hire 10-12 highly talented individuals with a range of experiences for our first cohort; while each person will be based in New York or London, they’ll collaborate with Xantium colleagues around the world. The overall experience shall enable Fellows to discover their natural niche, hone in on an ideal role and team, and transition into their permanent professional home at the end of the program. Program Structure Six-Month Timeline: The program begins with an “Initial Immersion” rotation featuring 10-12 weeks of immediate, hands-on deployment into real work alongside seasoned professionals. Fellows then transition into a 3-week cohort-wide classroom training led by experienced speakers and Xantium leadership hosted at one of Xantium’s main offices. The experience concludes with a 10-12 week “Capstone” rotation of more advanced deployment, allowing Fellows to build off their learnings to tackle another set of projects. Et puis nous avons continué... jobs.description_text: About Us: Endpoint is an interactive response technology (IRT®) systems and solutions provider that supports the life sciences industry. Our solutions, realized through the proprietary PULSE® platform, have proven to maximize the supply chain, minimize operational costs, and ensure timely and accurate patient dosing. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a driven and client-focused Programmatic Account Manager to join our US National team. You will manage a portfolio of brand direct and agency clients across our US Central region, acting as their primary point of contact from campaign kickoff through quarterly business reviews. You will combine strong programmatic expertise with a performance-first mindset to deliver measurable results, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about delivering impactful, client-centric solutions. The listed salary range reflects the base salary for this role and is dependent on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for a variable incentive plan and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description_text: About the Role We're looking for a Programmatic Customer Success professional to join our Curation team and help grow a book of partners across the digital advertising ecosystem, including agencies, curation providers, supply-side partners, retail and commerce media networks, and data providers. You don't need to be an expert in every part of programmatic advertising. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a foundation in programmatic advertising and curation, with room to grow into broader account ownership as our team and our partners' businesses scale. jobs.description_text: 👋 Hi! We are Equativ! Equativ is an AdTech leader created in 2001 on the belief that we can disrupt the on-line advertising industry. Headquartered in the heart of Paris and with offices in 19 countries, Equativ provides cutting-edge technologies that help hundreds of prestigious customers take back control and maximize their digital revenues with a flexible and transparent audience monetization platform. We can rely on a unique group of 700+ colleagues focused on excellence to shape our future. They continually embrace change and overcome challenges together to make innovation happen. That means we can offer you endless opportunities to do the same and let you shape the world you want! Equativ is looking for a proactive and strategic Sales Enablement Manager to join our Sales Enablement team. In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind our demand-side success across the APAC and MENA regions. You won't just be managing documents; you will be a key partner to our Sales teams, to plan, build, and continuously improve the collateral, tools and processes that help our sales teams win. By sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing, you will transform Equativ’s sophisticated tech capabilities into winning narratives that resonate with the world’s leading agencies and brands.

jobs.description_text: About the Role Equativ is looking for an SVP, National Sales to lead and grow our U.S. national sales an organization spanning New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada. We're looking for a sales leader who knows the programmatic advertising space, has deep relationships across major holding companies and independent agencies, and has a track record of growing revenue and winning new business. Just as important: someone who knows how to lead people. Externally, you're the face of Equativ's national sales effort, credible with senior agency and holding company decision-makers, comfortable in the room for the biggest pitches, and always looking for whitespace and new opportunity. Internally, you're building and running the team and setting the bar, creating consistency across three regions, coaching leaders and reps, and making the organization sharper and more accountable than it was before you got there. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to stay close to the market and close to the team, and who's ready to shape how national sales operates, competes, and wins. What You'll Do Lead the National Sales Organization Lead the North American national sales team across New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada setting clear priorities and creating alignment on where and how we grow. jobs.title: Team Lead, Account Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Team Lead, Account Manager at Equativ, you’ll play a pivotal role in delivering best-in-class service to our clients while ensuring seamless execution of campaigns. Sitting at the intersection of client relationships, campaign management, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Operations to maximize client satisfaction and business growth. This is an opportunity to work hands-on at the front lines of digital advertising, supporting both direct and programmatic campaigns for some of the industry’s most innovative partners.

jobs.title: VP, Operations and Services
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The VP, Operations & Services is a newly created leadership role responsible for bringing together the teams that support our commercial organization and customers across Ad Operations, Traffic Management, Account Management, and Demand Optimization. This leader will be responsible for creating greater consistency across these teams and how they work together, how they partner with Sales, and how we support our clients from the point a deal is signed through delivery and ongoing account management. We're looking for someone who has led operations and client service teams within ad tech or digital media and understands both programmatic and direct advertising. This person should be comfortable leading at the executive level while staying close enough to the business to understand what's working, where teams are getting stuck, and what needs to change. Teams & Scope This role will oversee the following functions, either directly or through their respective leaders: Ad Operations — campaign setup, trafficking, creative QA, and delivery across direct and programmatic channels Traffic Management — inventory allocation, pacing, and campaign flow across our platforms and tools Account Management / Client Services — day-to-day client relationships, renewals, and post-sale support across advertisers, agencies, and publisher partners Demand Optimization — yield, pricing, and inventory optimization in support of revenue and partner goals What You'll Do Lead the Organization

jobs.description_text: サービス営業アカウント・エグゼクティブ 本ポジションは、Extreme Networksにとって重要で大きな責任を伴う職務です。内部および外部のチームとの協力が必要とされます。主な焦点はエンドユーザー/顧客に置かれるべきですが、当社はチャネル主導型の企業であるため、ビジネス取引はチャネルを通じて行われます。理想的な候補者は、サービス営業エンジニアリングの経験があり、営業スキルを磨いた上で、サービス・アカウント・マネジメント職への転職を希望している人です。主な業務は、当社の新プラットフォームと機能を既存および新規顧客に提示し、価値を明確にし、新プラットフォームへの移行をサポートすることです。国内チームと協力して、Extreme Networksのポートフォリオから様々な業種にサービスソリューションを提供します。顧客およびチャネルパートナーの「信頼できるプロバイダー」としての役割を展開します。サービス・ソリューション・パイプラインと既存および新規顧客への関心を高める必要があります。カバレッジは日本全体です。 この職務に最も重要なのは、顧客の問題および質問に迅速に対応し、収益性の高いビジネスユニット内で解決策を特定および提供する能力と柔軟性です。営業チームと密接に協力して顧客の利益のために働き、チャネルパートナーと密接な協力をしながらも、最終ユーザー顧客に対して最高レベルのサポートを提供することが重要です。 主な職務内容 四半期ごとのターゲット見込み顧客リスト管理、日次・週次の営業活動、対面訪問やSNS活用、競合・市場分析、プレゼンテーションや提案書作成、顧客会議の調整などを含む営業開拓活動の推進 Professional ServicesおよびPremier Servicesを含むサービスソリューションの事業開発 リード創出から営業活動、サービス導入まで顧客のプログラムマネジメント 必要に応じた、チャネルパートナーおよびエンドユーザー企業の経営層に対するエンドツーエンドの導入後サポートの提供 Account Executiveと密接に協力し、新規および既存顧客の獲得・維持・拡大を推進 高付加価値サービスの提案・推進を通じたアカウント浸透率の向上 社内外のサービスレビューを企画・実施・主導し、サービスおよび運用改善に向けた提案を実施 技術的なエスカレーションや問題解決プロセスにおいて顧客の代弁者となること 保守更新、新規保守、サブスクリプション、Premier Services、Managed Services、Extreme Capital、Professional Servicesなど、Extremeのサービス提供内容を深く理解した上での顧客における新たなサービス機会の発掘 顧客向けデモおよびプリセールスプレゼンテーションの実施 Account Executiveに対するサービスソリューションポートフォリオのトレーニングの実施 サードパーティベンダーを含む経営層との連携 新規案件にけるサービスポートフォリオの適切な位置付け 新規案件におけるサービス契約のフォローアップおよびクロージング サービス売上認識および一般会計原則を理解 月次・四半期・年次の予測およびアカウントレビューの実施 担当アカウントのリスクおよび機会についての週次財務レポートの作成 契約の適時の請求処理を管理し、財務影響を把握 求められる人物像（個人的なスキル） 理想的な候補者は、営業スキルを習得しており、これからサービス・アカウント・マネジメント職への転職を希望しているサービス営業

jobs.title: Annotation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms. As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. jobs.title: Computer Vision Co-Op
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware, Inc. is actively seeking Computer Vision Co-Op Interns to join our Computer Vision Team at our Clifton Park, NY headquarters. This is a 6-month internship but has the potential to extend to 8 months. Kitware’s Computer Vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms, such as Kitware Image and Video Exploitation and Retrieval (KWIVER) toolkit. About the Projects: The Computer Vision Group is staffed by a multidisciplinary team of world-class experts in computer vision, deep learning, machine learning, and software engineering. We do a lot of development in C++ and Python with some JavaScript for web clients. We use OpenCV, ROS, Boost, Postgres, Caffe, Theano, VXL, and many other open source tools. jobs.title: Physics-Based Modeling Research Internship
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware is seeking a Physics-Based Modeling Research Intern to join the Computer Vision team. In this role, you'll develop computational models of biological systems that support cutting-edge research in medical imaging, biomechanics, physiology, and digital health. You'll work closely with software developers, AI researchers, clinicians, and domain scientists to create validated models that answer challenging scientific and clinical questions. About the Projects: Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Much of Kitware’s work involves applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and mechanistic modeling approaches to dynamic, real-world problems. We consider the work that we do on our government contracts as one of the ways that we give back to the community. We partner with premier government R&D agencies such as DARPA, IARPA, ARPA-H, DHA, AFRL, Army C5ISR, NOAA, and other branches of the US Government on a range of efforts, including prime contracts, SBIRs, and STTRs. In addition, we provide commercial services to companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary The Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control (QC) is responsible for providing strategic and operational oversight of QC activities supporting Lexeo's gene therapy programs. This role serves as a QC lead for external contract testing laboratories (CTLs), analytical lifecycle management (i.e., late-phase method validation), stability programs, release testing support, and analytical investigation activities. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experience

jobs.title: Scientist II, Analytical Development
jobs.description_text: Role Summary This Scientist II will independently design, execute, and analyze research studies and will drive one or more analytical development projects for AAV-based gene therapy programs. The role provides technical leadership in the development, optimization, qualification, validation, and transfer of analytical assays, including cell-based potency and molecular methods such as qPCR and ddPCR. The Scientist II will apply broad scientific knowledge and novel approaches to establish AAV mechanisms of action in cellular systems, resolve moderately complex technical issues, and support GMP manufacturing, material release, and regulatory submissions in collaboration with groups across CMC, Quality, QC, and external partners. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and effective in a fast-paced environment. The Scientist II is expected to exercise sound scientific judgment, communicate complex technical issues clearly, build alignment across functions, and serve as a technical resource to colleagues. This is a highly visible and impactful role in our CMC organization. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experrience
